question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**preys**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Blank 5 in the passage will imply how the advertisements target us and make us completely irrational.**
 
• **Among the given options, the correct word to use is "preys.**
 
 
• The word "preys" means to hunt and kill for food or to exploit or take advantage of someone.(शिकार)
 
• Example: He was an easy prey for the con men.
 
 
 
• In the given context, "preys" fits as it means to victimize someone.
 
• The sentence would make grammatical sense with "preys" as the verb for the third person present form "advertisement."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sacrifices: Giving up something valuable for a cause or belief.(बलि)
 
• Assassinates: To murder someone, usually a public figure.(हत्या)
 
• Victimises: To treat someone unfairly or harm them.(कष्ट पहुंचाना)
